name: @payswap/adversarial
description: Adversarial onchain/provider threat intelligence and immune-system integration (Work Order P6-W3): the security plane's immune system — the component-identity model, the threat-signature registry (matchable indicators scoped to vulnerable component identities and version ranges), the network-wide security-advisory registry with the GLOBAL restriction view (advisory outcomes map to restrict / quarantine / retire), the monotonic security-epoch authority (an epoch advance VOIDS every epoch-scoped authorization issued under it), the quarantine ledger (release ONLY through evidence-backed VERIFIED remediation plus advisory closure — never time-based), the INV-S03-style capability access gate (cached capability state can never bypass an active quarantine), the immutable security-learning feed (capability cases), the expert human-fallback bridge (evidence artifacts, never hidden authority) — PLUS the provider threat-intelligence vocabulary: the eleven provider threat families (deterministic detectors over provider observation bundles: provider outage, ambiguous provider outcomes, lost webhooks, clock skew, duplicated commands, partial payment, account takeover, malicious agents, package compromise, incentive Sybil/collusion/wash, leaderboard gaming), evidence-chain-mandatory signals with integer-bps calibrated confidence, and the adversarial provider agent (recommendation-only). INV-21 encoded: adversarial intelligence can ESCALATE to BLOCK and advise, but can NEVER downgrade or bypass a BLOCK decision (type + runtime + rejection). The D-1 wiring contract composes with the onchain-security kernel seam through STRUCTURAL PINS (zero sibling imports): advisory proposals project onto the kernel's advisory bridge shapes, the immune machinery state projects onto the kernel's composed OnchainSecurityState, and threat/advisory BLOCK-grade intelligence escalates into security-block registration proposals — harden-only, never soften. Deterministic only: pure functions, no ambient clock, no randomness, no network; zero runtime dependencies; devDependencies exactly typescript + vitest.
